info.name: Chaos Mesh Get archived chaos experiments

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by experiment name.

params.name: kind
params.description: Filter by chaos kind.

params.name: start
params.description: Filter events from this timestamp (RFC3339).

params.name: end
params.description: Filter events up to this timestamp (RFC3339).

items.docs: Returns a list of archived chaos experiments. Experiments are archived after they complete their configured duration or are manually deleted. Results can be filtered by namespace, name, kind, and time range.

params.name: uids
params.description: Comma-separated list of archive UIDs to delete.

items.docs: Deletes archived experiment records from the Chaos Mesh database. This removes historical records only, not live experiments.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get an archived chaos experiment

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific archived chaos experiment by its UID, including the original experiment spec and metadata.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Delete a specific archived experiment

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Deletes a single archived experiment record by its UID.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get archived schedule experiments

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by schedule name.

params.name: kind
params.description: Filter by chaos kind.

items.docs: Returns a list of archived chaos schedules that have been deleted or completed. Useful for reviewing historical scheduled chaos activity.

params.name: uids
params.description: Comma-separated list of archive UIDs to delete.

items.docs: Deletes multiple archived schedule records from the database.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get an archived schedule

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific archived schedule by its UID.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Delete an archived schedule

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Deletes a single archived schedule record by its UID.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to scope the request to.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by workflow name.

items.docs: Returns a list of archived chaos workflows that have been deleted or completed.

params.name: uids
params.description: Comma-separated list of archive UIDs to delete.

items.docs: Deletes multiple archived workflow records from the database.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get an archived workflow

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific archived workflow by its UID.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Delete an archived workflow

params.name: uid
params.description: UUID of the chaos resource.

items.docs: Deletes a single archived workflow record by its UID.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Kubernetes namespace to filter results by. If omitted, returns results from all namespaces.

params.name: name
params.description: Name substring to filter results by.

params.name: kind
params.description: Chaos type kind to filter by, such as PodChaos, NetworkChaos, IOChaos, StressChaos, HTTPChaos, TimeChaos, DNSChaos, or KernelChaos.

items.docs: Returns a list of archived (completed or deleted) chaos experiments. Archives provide a historical record of past chaos activity. Can be filtered by namespace, name, and kind.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Get an archived experiment

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the archived experiment.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific archived chaos experiment including its full spec, final status, and all associated events from its lifetime.

info.name: Chaos Mesh Delete an archive record

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the archived experiment.

items.docs: Permanently removes an archived experiment record from the database. This does not affect any running Kubernetes resources.
